item.title: Fort Tigne should remain open to the public, PN insists
item.description: Nationalist Party calls on government to issue clear position on whether it supports Din l-Art Ħelwa €2.5 million bid for Fort Tigné

item.title: Climate authority wants to use existing utility poles for EV charging points
item.description: Climate Action Authority wants to introduce electric trickle chargers on existing utility poles in places where vehicles are often parked for extended periods

item.title: Man kept in custody after violent attack on his roommates
item.description: Roommate went to Qawra police station with blood on her face after the alleged attack

item.title: Drug suspect granted bail despite prosecution citing multiple past breaches
item.description: Prosecution described accused as 'toxic' and not to be trusted, but court opted to grant bail against €15,000 guarantee

item.title: Robert Abela insists Malta aid to Ukraine will not be used on lethal weapons in line with constitution
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela confirms Malta will support a major EU financial aid package for Ukraine, insisting any contribution will not be linked to the funding of lethal weapons • Opposition leader says EU must balance solidarity with constitutional realities

item.title: Airport winter traffic growth outpaces summer increase
item.description: The Malta International Airport said its winter traffic grew by 16% year-on-year, beating summer growth by 5%. Some 10.5 million passengers are expected to move through the airport in 2026

item.title: Maltese prime minister, opposition leader voice solidarity with Iranian people
item.description: As tensions continue to escalate in Iran, Prime Minister Robert Abela and Opposition leader Alex Borg voice solidarity with Iranian people • US, UK start withdrawing personnel from Middle East bases, embassies

item.title: In Israel Malta is perceived as ‘anti-Israeli’, but reality on the ground different, ambassador says
item.description: Israel’s ambassador Ruth Cohen-Dar tells parliament’s Foreign Affairs Committee while people in her country perceive Malta as ‘anti-Israeli’, her experience on the ground tells a different story

item.title: Woman denied bail over heroin and cocaine dealing
item.description: Woman denied bail over alleged trafficking despite defence arguing she did it to sustain addiction

item.title: ‘I’m going to kill you’: Accused remanded in custody after putting gun to man’s head
